    assert sorted_list_sum(["aa", "a", "aaa"]) == ["aa"]

    assert sorted_list_sum(["ab", "a", "aaa", "cd"]) == ["ab", "cd"]

    assert sorted_list_sum([]) == []

    # All odd lengths -> empty result
    assert sorted_list_sum(["a", "abc", "abcde"]) == []

    # All even lengths
    assert sorted_list_sum(["ab", "abcd", "abcdef"]) == ["ab", "abcd", "abcdef"]

    # Ties in length resolved lexicographically (lst.sort() then stable sort by len)
    assert sorted_list_sum(["bb", "aa", "cc"]) == ["aa", "bb", "cc"]

    # Single element, even length
    assert sorted_list_sum(["hello"]) == []

    # Single element, even length
    assert sorted_list_sum(["hi"]) == ["hi"]

    # Duplicates preserved
    assert sorted_list_sum(["ab", "ab", "abc"]) == ["ab", "ab"]

    assert sorted_list_sum(["school", "AI", "asdf", "b"]) == ["AI", "asdf", "school"]

    assert sorted_list_sum(["aaa", "aa", "a"]) == ["aa"]
